*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/generate.py
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib
+
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+data = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INT AS year,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+if data["year"].tolist() != expected_years:
+    raise ValueError(f"Unexpected year coverage: {data['year'].tolist()}")
+
+years = data["year"].tolist()
+deaths = data["pedestrian_deaths"].tolist()
+answers = (
+    "Annual totals: "
+    + "; ".join(f"{year}: {count}" for year, count in zip(years, deaths))
+    + "."
+)
+
+for option_id in (1, 2, 3):
+    data.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5.8))
+ax.bar(years, deaths, color="#2c7fb8", width=0.75)
+ax.set(title="Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year",
+       xlabel="Year of crash", ylabel="Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(deaths) * 1.16)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.bar_label(ax.containers[0], padding=3, fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5.8))
+ax.plot(years, deaths, color="#d95f0e", marker="o", linewidth=2)
+ax.set(title="Annual pedestrian deaths in NYC motor vehicle crashes",
+       xlabel="Year of crash", ylabel="Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(deaths) * 1.16)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+for year, count in zip(years, deaths):
+    ax.annotate(str(count), (year, count), xytext=(0, 7),
+                textcoords="offset points", ha="center", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6.2))
+ax.scatter(deaths, years, color="#238b45", s=55, zorder=3)
+ax.set(title="Pedestrian deaths by crash year (dot plot)",
+       xlabel="Pedestrians killed (count)", ylabel="Year of crash")
+ax.set_yticks(years)
+ax.set_xlim(0, max(deaths) * 1.16)
+ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)
+for count, year in zip(deaths, years):
+    ax.annotate(str(count), (count, year), xytext=(7, 0),
+                textcoords="offset points", va="center", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed",
+            "denominator": "None (absolute annual count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
+            "chart_type": "Vertical bar chart",
+            "reason": "A bar chart makes comparisons between discrete annual totals straightforward.",
+            "probability": 0.55,
+            "answer": answers,
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed",
+            "denominator": "None (absolute annual count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "A line chart emphasizes how the yearly total changes over time.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": answers,
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 3,
+            "metric": "Sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed",
+            "denominator": "None (absolute annual count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year of crash_date",
+            "chart_type": "Dot plot",
+            "reason": "A dot plot presents each year's count on one common scale without bars connecting the values.",
+            "probability": 0.15,
+            "answer": answers,
+        },
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
*** End Patch
